data.name: BarcodeScanControl_Desc
data.value: Button that opens the native device barcode/QR scanner (Device.getBarcodeValue) and exposes the scanned code as plain text. Built for canvas apps; statically typed outputs survive YAML round-trips.

data.name: value_Display
data.comment: Display name for the scanned value output

data.name: value_Desc
data.value: The text of the most recently scanned barcode or QR code. Empty until the first successful scan.
data.comment: Description for the scanned value output

data.name: scanCount_Display
data.comment: Display name for the scan counter output

data.name: scanCount_Desc
data.value: Number of successful scans since the control loaded. Increments even when the same code is scanned twice, so OnChange fires reliably.
data.comment: Description for the scan counter output

data.name: errorMessage_Display
data.comment: Display name for the error output

data.name: errorMessage_Desc
data.value: Localized error text when the scanner is unavailable or failed. Empty after a successful scan or when the user simply cancelled.

data.name: buttonText_Display
data.comment: Display name for the caption input

data.name: buttonText_Desc
data.value: Caption shown on the button. Leave empty for the localized default (DE / EN / FR).

data.name: fillColor_Display
data.comment: Display name for the fill color input

data.name: fillColor_Desc
data.value: CSS color for the button background, e.g. #E2001A or rgba(226,0,26,1). Default: #0F6CBD.
data.comment: Description for the fill color input

data.name: textColor_Display
data.comment: Display name for the text color input

data.name: textColor_Desc
data.value: CSS color for caption and icon. Default: #FFFFFF.
data.comment: Description for the text color input

data.name: fontSize_Display
data.comment: Display name for the font size input

data.name: fontSize_Desc
data.comment: Description for the font size input
